I'm telling you, I've been thinking about going vegetarian for ages now. I'm tellin' ya, I don't understand this modern art business. I mean, I saw this exhibit down at the gallery in Norwich, and it was just a bunch of splatters on a canvas. The gallery, the lighting, the other pieces around it – all of those things can influence how we experience and interpret the art. I've been teachin' a course on contemporary art, and one of the things we've been discussin' is the role of the viewer in creatin' the meaning of the artwork. Although, as art historians, we do try to provide some context and framework for understandin' and appreciatin' different types of art.

...and then she just spit it right back out at me. I swear, this weaning business is a nightmare. I'm starting to think she's just not ready yet. Oh, Mum, don't worry, it's normal. I'm so glad we decided to take a walk today, the countryside is looking particularly beautiful. The hills are so green and lush, it's like a perfect picture postcard. Ah'm tellin' thee, it were a reight good do at t'anniversary party last weekend! Our whole family got together, and it were lovely to catch up wi' everyone. How did tha enjoy it, lad? I'm tellin' ya, I don't know how you young folks keep up with all these new-fangled gadgets. I mean, I've got me mobile phone, but I only use it for rangin' me mates and checkin' the weather. Blud, I'm so done with this Valentine's Day fuss. I mean, I was at the cinema with my mates on Friday evening, and it was like, couples everywhere. I'm telling you, it's unbelievable the way they're handling the racism issue in the States. I mean, it's like they're not even trying to address it properly. I know, right? It's crazy.
